_note: Every word of a sheet or a content template, by key, in the three languages (tools/generate.py replaces each {key} of source/ by its text). The terms of a clause are those of the edition of the norm in that language (SIA 265:2021 DE and FR; English after EN 1995 where SIA has no English edition); `paths` names every folder and file in fr and de, English being the source's own name.
